# Papers on speech emotion recognition, emotional TTS, urban flow and OD demand prediction, and hyperspectral image classification

> Paper pages with verified summaries, quick facts, quoted results, abstracts, FAQs and BibTeX. Topics: speech emotion recognition, emotion-controllable text-to-speech for diffusion and flow-matching models, urban flow prediction, origin-destination demand prediction, hyperspectral image classification.

Preferred citation: the BibTeX on each paper page or at https://codezx6.github.io/publications.bib.

## Topic overviews

- [Speech emotion recognition and emotional text-to-speech for humanoid robots](https://codezx6.github.io/topics/speech-emotion.html): Two 2026 arXiv papers address both directions of affective speech: recognising emotion in speech (PhysioSER; Zhang, Cao, Yang and Wu, 2026) and generating emotional speech (DUET; Zhang, Cao and Wu, 2026). Both methods are designed as compact plug-in components for large pretrained speech models, and both were deployed on a humanoid robot.
- [Urban flow prediction with masked and contrastive spatio-temporal pre-training](https://codezx6.github.io/topics/urban-flow-prediction.html): Urban flow prediction forecasts future flows across city regions from historical flow data and supports services such as trip planning, congestion control, and public safety. Three papers (Zhang et al., CIKM 2023; Zhang et al., Knowledge-Based Systems 2023; Zhang et al., Neural Networks 2025) develop self-supervised spatio-temporal pre-training for this task.
- [Origin-destination (OD) flow and demand prediction for metro and taxi systems](https://codezx6.github.io/topics/origin-destination-prediction.html): Origin-destination (OD) prediction forecasts the flow or demand between pairs of stations or regions, which supports real-time traffic management, vehicle dispatch, and resource allocation in intelligent transportation systems. Two papers (Yu et al., Expert Systems with Applications 2025; Gong et al., Expert Systems with Applications 2026) study this problem on metro and taxi data.
- [Hyperspectral image classification: cross-domain few-shot learning and superpixel mutual enhancement](https://codezx6.github.io/topics/hyperspectral-image-classification.html): Two IEEE Transactions on Geoscience and Remote Sensing papers (Cao et al., 2024; Cao et al., 2025) study hyperspectral image (HSI) classification.
- [中文论文索引](https://codezx6.github.io/zh/): Chinese titles and summaries of every paper

## Papers

- [DUET: Unified Dual-Space Emotion Control for Diffusion and Flow-Matching Driven Text-to-Speech](https://codezx6.github.io/papers/duet.html): Xu Zhang, Longbing Cao, Zhangkai Wu. arXiv:2606.00066 (2026). DOI 10.48550/arXiv.2606.00066. DUET adds fine-grained, plug-and-play emotion control to pretrained diffusion and flow-matching TTS models by steering a linearly decodable emotion direction in hidden space and guiding the mel output through a differentiable vocoder, with no retraining.
- [PhysioSER: Learning Physiology-Informed Vocal Spectrotemporal Representations for Speech Emotion Recognition](https://codezx6.github.io/papers/physioser.html): Xu Zhang, Longbing Cao, Runze Yang, Zhangkai Wu. arXiv:2602.13259 (2026). DOI 10.48550/arXiv.2602.13259. PhysioSER couples vocal amplitude and phase through voice anatomy and physiology (VAP) informed quaternion representations, aligned with a frozen self-supervised backbone, giving an interpretable and efficient plug-and-play speech emotion recognizer validated on 14 datasets and 10 languages.
- [DSTCN: Exploiting dynamic spatio-temporal correlations for origin-destination demand prediction](https://codezx6.github.io/papers/dstcn.html): Yongshun Gong, Piao Yu, Xu Zhang, Xinxin Zhang, Xiushan Nie, Haoliang Sun. Expert Systems with Applications, vol. 299, 130095 (2026). DOI 10.1016/j.eswa.2025.130095. DSTCN (Dynamic Spatio-Temporal Correlation Network) forecasts origin-destination demand with three modules: Glstm2D for bidirectional origin/destination demand trends, Simformer for Transformer-based inter-regional similarity over the OD matrix, and FF-TM for temporal fusion; it beats state-of-the-art baselines on NYC-TOD2018, NYC-TOD2019, and HZMetro.
- [S2CMEN: A Mutually Enhancement Network for Superpixel Segmentation and Classification of Hyperspectral Image](https://codezx6.github.io/papers/mutual-enhancement-hsi.html): Mengxin Cao, Yongmin Li, Xu Zhang, Guixin Zhao, Guohua Lv, Aimei Dong, Jinyong Cheng, Wei Li, Xiangjun Dong. IEEE Transactions on Geoscience and Remote Sensing, vol. 63, 1–14 (2025). DOI 10.1109/TGRS.2025.3608942. A network in which superpixel segmentation and hyperspectral classification reinforce each other, so segmentation boundaries and class predictions improve jointly.
- [MR-UFP: Enhancing urban flow prediction via mutual reinforcement with multi-scale regional information](https://codezx6.github.io/papers/mr-ufp.html): Xu Zhang, Mengxin Cao, Yongshun Gong, Xiaoming Wu, Xiangjun Dong, Ying Guo, Long Zhao, Chengqi Zhang. Neural Networks, vol. 182, 106900 (2025). DOI 10.1016/j.neunet.2024.106900. MR-UFP improves urban flow prediction on small or noisy data by pre-training with spatial-temporal masking and contrastive learning, then jointly training the predictor with a multi-scale region-classification task that mutually reinforces spatial features.
- [BiST-IF: Enhancing origin–destination flow prediction via bi-directional spatio-temporal inference and interconnected feature evolution](https://codezx6.github.io/papers/bist-if.html): Piao Yu, Xu Zhang, Yongshun Gong, Jian Zhang, Haoliang Sun, Junjie Zhang, Xinxin Zhang, Yilong Yin. Expert Systems with Applications, vol. 264, 125679 (2025). DOI 10.1016/j.eswa.2024.125679. BiST-IF predicts metro and taxi origin-destination flows by correcting delayed OD matrices, applying bi-directional origin/destination attention, and letting OD and arrival (Out-OD) flows evolve jointly through mutual-information attention.
- [Automatic visual recognition for leaf disease based on enhanced attention mechanism](https://codezx6.github.io/papers/leaf-disease-attention.html): Yumeng Yao, Xiaodun Deng, Xu Zhang, Junming Li, Wenxuan Sun, Gechao Zhang. PeerJ Computer Science, vol. 10, e2365 (2024). DOI 10.7717/peerj-cs.2365. An enhanced-attention vision model for fast and accurate recognition of tomato leaf diseases, aimed at early disease prevention in agriculture.
- [S3CFSL: Spatial-Spectral–Semantic Cross-Domain Few-Shot Learning for Hyperspectral Image Classification](https://codezx6.github.io/papers/spatial-spectral-semantic-fsl.html): Mengxin Cao, Xu Zhang, Jinyong Cheng, Guixin Zhao, Wei Li, Xiangjun Dong. IEEE Transactions on Geoscience and Remote Sensing, vol. 62, 1–15 (2024). DOI 10.1109/TGRS.2024.3434484. A cross-domain few-shot learner for hyperspectral images that jointly exploits spatial, spectral, and semantic information to classify new scenes from very few labelled samples.
- [ST-CSL: Spatio-temporal fusion and contrastive learning for urban flow prediction](https://codezx6.github.io/papers/st-csl.html): Xu Zhang, Yongshun Gong, Chengqi Zhang, Xiaoming Wu, Ying Guo, Wenpeng Lu, Long Zhao, Xiangjun Dong. Knowledge-Based Systems, vol. 282, 111104 (2023). DOI 10.1016/j.knosys.2023.111104. ST-CSL fuses temporal-view and spatial-view contrastive learning so an urban flow predictor captures global periodicity and the hidden flow relationships between functionally similar regions.
- [MCSTL: Mask- and Contrast-Enhanced Spatio-Temporal Learning for Urban Flow Prediction](https://codezx6.github.io/papers/mcstl.html): Xu Zhang, Yongshun Gong, Xinxin Zhang, Xiaoming Wu, Chengqi Zhang, Xiangjun Dong. CIKM 2023, pp. 3298–3307. DOI 10.1145/3583780.3614958. MCSTL pre-trains an urban flow model with a mask-reconstruction task across space and time and a graph-based contrastive task that weights regions by inter-regional attention, then fine-tunes for flow prediction.
- [URMDet-SimFire: Trustworthy multimodal detection with uncertainty and reliability modeling for fire and smoke analytics](https://codezx6.github.io/papers/urmdet-simfire.html): Zhonghua Dang, Xu Zhang. Array, vol. 31, 101124 (2026). DOI 10.1016/j.array.2026.101124. A trustworthy multimodal fire-and-smoke detector that models uncertainty and reliability of each modality.
